resources.string: Open Ava using your accessibility shortcut, assistant gesture, home widget, or an optional Nothing Essential Key. Avenire checks app and window metadata against capture exclusions before taking a frozen preview; it does not read accessibility text or form fields. Browser screens, excluded apps, locked screens, and ambiguous windows are not captured. Opening Ava keeps the preview on this device. With Share screen with Ava enabled, Send shares the permitted preview with Ava for explanations and annotations. No continuous recording.
